items.title: How Investors May Respond To Invesco (IVZ) Strong Q3 Revenue Growth
items.summary: Invesco reported Q3 2026 revenue of US$1,873.2 million, higher than a year earlier, with assets under management reaching about US$2.5 trillion. Net income and earnings per share from continuing operations were slightly lower than the prior period, and adjusted EPS did not meet analyst forecasts.
